criteria.criterion: Access the official Python image Tags page on Docker Hub and search for '3.12-slim'
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent reached the correct official tags page and performed the search/filter for “3.12-slim” without signing in. No blockers shown.

criteria.criterion: Filter to only tag names that begin exactly with '3.12-slim' (exact-prefix match)
criteria.final_justification: Full verification for three tags is not possible from the screenshots because only one exact-prefix tag is visible. However, the filtering approach is correct and the visible result satisfies the exact-prefix rule; there’s no evidence the agent included a non-prefix substring match. Award partial credit rather than full because two of the three reported tags are not evidenced.

criteria.criterion: Identify the three most recently updated tags among the exact-prefix matches (or report limitations)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s output claims three most-recent tags, but the screenshots only support identifying recency for a single matching tag. This is a controllable shortcoming (insufficiently evidenced selection of the top three), not an uncontrollable blocker. Minimal partial credit for at least using the correct sort setting and identifying one match as recent.

criteria.criterion: Report required displayed fields for each of the (up to) three selected tags (no guessing)
criteria.final_justification: For one tag, the linux/amd64 size and an update time (relative) are supported by the screenshot, but the agent fabricated/overstated an exact calendar timestamp and provided additional tags’ fields without evidence (and did not mark them unavailable). This is a substantive accuracy issue, so only limited credit is warranted for the one correctly evidenced linux/amd64 size.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (no sign-in; no pulling/running images)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints are respected: no sign-in and no pulling/running images is evidenced. Full credit.
